## Who is Aqeel Shamsudheen?

Aqeel Shamsudheen (also known as aqeelshamz) is a full-stack developer who takes products end-to-end: idea → architecture → UI → backend → deployment → real usage. He specializes in shipping fast, working solo, and building revenue-generating software rather than demos or side projects.

## Skills & Stack

- Mobile: Flutter, Dart (cross-platform iOS & Android apps)
- Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript
- Backend: Node.js, MongoDB, REST APIs, Firebase, FastAPI, GraphQL
- AI: Generative AI, AI Agents, multi-model AI products
- Design: UI/UX, Figma, conversion-focused interfaces

## Experience

- Founder, Wixzel (Mar 2026 — present): building and shipping products end-to-end. https://www.wixzel.com
- Software Engineer, Crink.App (Aug 2025 — Feb 2026): Cri App, an AI Wellbeing Coach. Kochi, Kerala.
- Full-stack Developer, Teqnify Solutions (Mar 2025 — Aug 2025): built Darsmate, Mentorsa, and Sprint Learning App — complete educational ecosystems (mobile apps, admin panels, backend).
- Flutter Developer Intern, iTurn (Jun 2024 — Mar 2025): on-demand driving training app used across India.
- Full-stack Developer, Darsmate Learning App (Aug 2023 — Mar 2024): Islamic e-learning platform.
- Freelance Flutter & Full-stack Developer (Oct 2021 — May 2023): Edifice Learning App, Alwadi International School App, a Calendly clone, and a Typeform clone — all live in production.

## Notable Projects

- Wixzel One — AI-powered instant app maker for your phone. Tell it what you need in one sentence and it builds a real, working mini app in minutes — no coding, no app store, live with a shareable link. Also builds personal storefronts with WhatsApp ordering and payments via the owner's own Razorpay or Stripe: https://one.wixzel.com/
